releaseNotes:
Add 딸기 망고 블루베리 스무디 product; tune default Y positions

- New default product 딸기 망고 블루베리 스무디 (ID 8800341260024) with the
  shared default recipe profile + auto-seeded default mixing step.
- Default Y mixing position (Y축 제조 위치) pos 40 -> 60.
- Default Y clean position (Y축 세척 위치) pos 65 -> 80.

Seed-only (back-fill), so these reach freshly provisioned tablets;
deployed devices keep their existing recipe list and Y configs.
